<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="zh-CN" data-theme="mc-wiki">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
<title>红石的答辩wiki</title>
<link rel="icon" href="data:image/svg+xml,<svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 100 100'><text y='.9em' font-size='90'>🧱</text></svg>">
<style>
/* ==================== 主题变量 ==================== */
:root,[data-theme="mc-wiki"]{
  --bg:#fffdf5;--bg2:#f4f0e0;--bg3:#e8e2cc;--text:#1f1f1f;--muted:#5c5c5c;
  --bd:#a8a89a;--bd2:#4a4a3a;--ac:#3d521f;--acs:#e0e8d0;--dgr:#a02020;
  --ok:#2d7a2d;--warn:#b08800;--cbg:#f0ecd8;
  --sh:2px 2px 0 rgba(0,0,0,.2);--r:2px;
  --blob1:rgba(61,82,31,.10);--blob2:rgba(106,140,60,.07);--blob3:rgba(180,150,80,.06);
  --grid:rgba(61,82,31,.04);
  --bevel:inset -1px -1px 0 rgba(0,0,0,.15),inset 1px 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.7);
  --bevel-in:inset 1px 1px 0 rgba(0,0,0,.15),inset -1px -1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.7);
  --font:"Segoe UI","PingFang SC","Microsoft YaHei",sans-serif;
  --nav-active-bg:#3d521f;--nav-active-fg:#fff;
  --btn-bg:linear-gradient(180deg,#e8e2cc,#d4ceb8);
  --btn-fg:#1f1f1f;--btn-bd:#4a4a3a;
  --btn-primary-bg:linear-gradient(180deg,#7a9c3c,#56682c);
  --btn-primary-fg:#fff;
  --h1-border:2px solid #3d521f;
  --h2-bg:linear-gradient(180deg,#7a9c3c,#56682c);--h2-fg:#fff;
  --particle:61,82,31;
  --tile-accent:linear-gradient(135deg,#7a9c3c,#3d521f);
  --hero-grad:linear-gradient(135deg,#3d521f 0%,#7a9c3c 100%);
  --sidebar-w:240px;
  --gap:12px;
  --card-pad:12px 14px;
}
/* 其余主题变量不变，省略（与原代码相同） */
[data-theme="github-light"]{/* ... */--sidebar-w:240px;--gap:12px;--card-pad:12px 14px;}
[data-theme="github-dark"]{/* ... */--sidebar-w:240px;--gap:12px;--card-pad:12px 14px;}
[data-theme="mc-night"]{/* ... */--sidebar-w:240px;--gap:12px;--card-pad:12px 14px;}

*,*::before,*::after{box-sizing:border-box}
html{background:var(--bg);scroll-behavior:smooth}
body{margin:0;background:transparent;color:var(--text);font-family:var(--font);font-size:14.5px;line-height:1.6;-webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased;overflow-x:hidden;transition:background-color .3s,color .3s}

/* 背景装饰 — 更淡 */
.bg-decor{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:0;overflow:hidden;pointer-events:none}
.blob{position:absolute;border-radius:50%;filter:blur(80px);will-change:transform}
.b1{width:400px;height:400px;background:var(--blob1);top:-140px;left:-120px;animation:drift1 28s ease-in-out infinite}
.b2{width:460px;height:460px;background:var(--blob2);bottom:-180px;right:-160px;animation:drift2 34s ease-in-out infinite}
.b3{width:320px;height:320px;background:var(--blob3);top:38%;left:52%;animation:drift3 40s ease-in-out infinite}
@keyframes drift1{0%,100%{transform:translate(0,0) scale(1)}33%{transform:translate(60px,50px) scale(1.1)}66%{transform:translate(-40px,70px) scale(.95)}}
@keyframes drift2{0%,100%{transform:translate(0,0) scale(1)}40%{transform:translate(-70px,-60px) scale(1.05)}70%{transform:translate(30px,-100px) scale(.94)}}
@keyframes drift3{0%,100%{transform:translate(0,0) scale(1)}50%{transform:translate(-60px,-70px) scale(1.12)}}
.grid-bg{position:absolute;inset:0;
  background-image:linear-gradient(var(--grid) 1px,transparent 1px),linear-gradient(90deg,var(--grid) 1px,transparent 1px);
  background-size:36px 36px;
  -webkit-mask-image:radial-gradient(ellipse 85% 75% at 50% 40%,#000 20%,transparent 75%);
  mask-image:radial-gradient(ellipse 85% 75% at 50% 40%,#000 20%,transparent 75%)}
#particles{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;display:block;opacity:.6}

#progress{position:fixed;top:0;left:0;height:2px;width:0;z-index:60;background:var(--ac);transition:width .1s linear}

#boot{padding:100px 24px;text-align:center;color:var(--muted);font-size:13px;position:relative;z-index:1}
.spin{display:inline-block;width:16px;height:16px;margin-right:8px;vertical-align:-3px;border:2px solid var(--bd);border-top-color:var(--ac);border-radius:50%;animation:sp .7s linear infinite}
@keyframes sp{to{transform:rotate(360deg)}}

/* ==================== 顶栏 — 紧凑 ==================== */
.topbar{position:fixed;top:0;left:0;right:0;height:46px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;padding:0 10px;background:var(--bg);border-bottom:1px solid var(--bd);z-index:50;transition:box-shadow .25s,background .3s}
[data-theme^="mc-"] .topbar{background:linear-gradient(180deg,#56682c,#3d521f);border-bottom:2px solid #2a3a1a;color:#fff}
[data-theme="mc-night"] .topbar{background:linear-gradient(180deg,#2a3a1a,#1a2a0a);border-bottom:2px solid #0a1a00;color:#e8ffd0}
.topbar.scrolled{box-shadow:0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,.08)}
.logo{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;font-size:14px;font-weight:700;color:var(--text);text-decoration:none;white-space:nowrap;cursor:pointer}
[data-theme^="mc-"] .logo{color:#fff;text-shadow:1px 1px 0 rgba(0,0,0,.4)}
[data-theme="mc-night"] .logo{color:#e8ffd0}
.logo-icon{display:inline-block;font-size:16px;transition:transform .3s cubic-bezier(.34,1.56,.64,1)}
.logo:hover .logo-icon{transform:rotate(-8deg) scale(1.08)}

.search{position:relative;flex:1;max-width:360px}
.search svg{position:absolute;left:9px;top:50%;transform:translateY(-50%);color:var(--muted);pointer-events:none;transition:color .2s}
[data-theme^="mc-"] .search svg{color:rgba(255,255,255,.7)}
.search input{width:100%;height:30px;padding:0 10px 0 30px;font-size:13px;font-family:inherit;color:var(--text);background:var(--bg2);border:1px solid var(--bd);border-radius:var(--r);outline:none;transition:border-color .2s,box-shadow .2s}
[data-theme^="mc-"] .search input{border:2px solid #2a3a1a;background:#fffdf5;color:#1f1f1f;box-shadow:var(--bevel-in)}
[data-theme="mc-night"] .search input{background:#202020;color:#e0e0e0;border-color:#0a1a00}
.search input:focus{background:var(--bg);border-color:var(--ac);box-shadow:0 0 0 2px var(--acs)}
[data-theme^="mc-"] .search input:focus{box-shadow:0 0 6px rgba(142,196,74,.4)}
.search input::placeholder{color:var(--muted)}

.icon{display:grid;place-items:center;width:30px;height:30px;flex:none;font-size:14px;font-family:inherit;color:var(--muted);background:transparent;border:none;border-radius:var(--r);cursor:pointer;transition:background .15s,color .15s,transform .2s}
.icon:hover{background:var(--bg3);color:var(--text)}
[data-theme^="mc-"] .icon{color:rgba(255,255,255,.85)}
[data-theme^="mc-"] .icon:hover{background:rgba(0,0,0,.2);color:#fff}
.icon:active{transform:scale(.92)}
.icon.active{background:var(--acs);color:var(--ac)}
.icon[hidden]{display:none!important}
.menu{display:grid}
#menuBtn svg{transition:transform .3s}
body.sidebar-open #menuBtn svg{transform:rotate(90deg)}

/* ==================== 按钮 ==================== */
.btn{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:5px;padding:5px 12px;font-size:13px;font-family:inherit;font-weight:600;color:var(--btn-fg);background:var(--btn-bg);border:1px solid var(--btn-bd);border-radius:var(--r);cursor:pointer;box-shadow:var(--bevel);transition:background .15s,transform .15s,box-shadow .15s}
.btn:hover:not(:disabled){filter:brightness(1.05);transform:translateY(-1px)}
[data-theme^="mc-"] .btn:hover:not(:disabled){transform:none;filter:brightness(1.08);box-shadow:var(--bevel),0 0 8px rgba(142,196,74,.3)}
.btn:active:not(:disabled){transform:translateY(0);box-shadow:var(--bevel-in)}
.btn:disabled{opacity:.5;cursor:not-allowed}
.btn.p{color:var(--btn-primary-fg);background:var(--btn-primary-bg);border-color:var(--btn-bd)}
.btn.d{color:var(--dgr);background:transparent}
.btn.d:hover:not(:disabled){background:rgba(207,34,46,.08);filter:none}

/* ==================== 侧边栏 — 紧凑 ==================== */
.sidebar{position:fixed;top:46px;bottom:0;left:0;width:var(--sidebar-w);display:flex;flex-direction:column;padding:0;background:var(--bg2);border-right:1px solid var(--bd);z-index:40;transform:translateX(-100%);transition:transform .28s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1),background .3s;box-shadow:1px 0 6px rgba(0,0,0,.05)}
body.sidebar-open .sidebar{transform:none}
[data-theme^="mc-"] .sidebar{background:#e8e2cc;border-right:2px solid #a8a89a;box-shadow:2px 0 0 rgba(0,0,0,.1)}
[data-theme="mc-night"] .sidebar{background:#1e1e1e;border-right:2px solid #404040}

.sidebar-head{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;padding:8px 10px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--bd);flex:none}
[data-theme^="mc-"] .sidebar-head{border-bottom:2px solid #a8a89a}
.sidebar-head .stitle{flex:1;font-size:11px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.08em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--muted)}
.sidebar-head .icon{width:26px;height:26px;font-size:12px}
.sidebar-body{flex:1;min-height:0;overflow-y:auto;padding:8px}
.sidebar-foot{flex:none;padding:8px 10px 10px;border-top:1px solid var(--bd)}
[data-theme^="mc-"] .sidebar-foot{border-top:2px solid #a8a89a}

/* 目录树 — 紧凑 */
.tree{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:2px}
.tree-node{margin:0}
.tree-head{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:5px;padding:4px 6px;border-radius:var(--r);cursor:pointer;user-select:none;transition:background .12s;font-size:12.5px;color:var(--text)}
.tree-head:hover{background:var(--bg3)}
.tree-arrow{width:12px;height:12px;flex:none;display:grid;place-items:center;font-size:8px;color:var(--muted);transition:transform .2s cubic-bezier(.34,1.56,.64,1)}
.tree-node.open > .tree-head > .tree-arrow{transform:rotate(90deg)}
.tree-label{flex:1;min-width:0;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap;font-weight:600}
.tree-count{font-size:10px;color:var(--muted);padding:0 5px;background:var(--bg);border-radius:8px;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;transition:background .2s,color .2s}
[data-theme^="mc-"] .tree-count{border-radius:2px;border:1px solid var(--bd)}
.tree-node.open > .tree-head .tree-count{background:var(--acs);color:var(--ac)}

.tree-chapter > .tree-head{font-size:13px;font-weight:700;padding:5px 8px;background:var(--bg);border:1px solid var(--bd);box-shadow:var(--bevel)}
[data-theme^="mc-"] .tree-chapter > .tree-head{background:linear-gradient(180deg,#7a9c3c,#56682c);color:#fff;text-shadow:1px 1px 0 rgba(0,0,0,.3);border:2px solid #3d521f}
[data-theme^="mc-"] .tree-chapter > .tree-head .tree-arrow{color:rgba(255,255,255,.85)}
[data-theme^="mc-"] .tree-chapter > .tree-head .tree-count{background:rgba(0,0,0,.25);color:#e8ffd0;border-color:rgba(0,0,0,.3)}
[data-theme="mc-night"] .tree-chapter > .tree-head{background:linear-gradient(180deg,#5a7a2c,#3d521f);color:#e8ffd0}
.tree-chapter > .tree-head:hover{filter:brightness(1.03)}

.tree-body{overflow:hidden;max-height:0;transition:max-height .28s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1)}
.tree-node.open > .tree-body{max-height:5000px}
.tree-chapter > .tree-body{padding:4px 0 2px 8px}
.tree-section > .tree-body{padding:2px 0 2px 10px}
.tree-category > .tree-body{padding:2px 0 4px 12px}

.tree-section > .tree-head{font-size:12.5px;font-weight:600;padding:4px 6px}
.tree-section > .tree-head .tree-label::before{content:"§";margin-right:3px;color:var(--ac);font-weight:800}
[data-theme^="mc-"] .tree-section > .tree-head .tree-label::before{content:"▸";color:#3d521f}
[data-theme="mc-night"] .tree-section > .tree-head .tree-label::before{color:#8ec44a}

.tree-category > .tree-head{font-size:12px;padding:3px 6px;color:var(--muted);font-weight:500}
.tree-category > .tree-head .tree-label::before{content:"#";margin-right:2px;color:var(--ac);opacity:.7;font-weight:700}
[data-theme^="mc-"] .tree-category > .tree-head .tree-label::before{content:"▪";color:#56682c}
.tree-category > .tree-head:hover{color:var(--text)}

.nav-i{display:block;padding:3px 8px 3px 12px;font-size:12.5px;color:var(--text);text-decoration:none;border-radius:var(--r);margin:1px 0;position:relative;transition:background .12s,color .12s;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap}
.nav-i::before{content:"";position:absolute;left:3px;top:50%;width:3px;height:3px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--muted);opacity:.5;transform:translateY(-50%);transition:all .18s}
[data-theme^="mc-"] .nav-i::before{border-radius:0;width:2px;height:2px;background:#4a4a3a}
.nav-i:hover{background:var(--bg3);color:var(--text)}
.nav-i.active{background:var(--nav-active-bg);color:var(--nav-active-fg);font-weight:600}
.nav-i.active::before{background:var(--ac);opacity:1;box-shadow:0 0 0 2px var(--acs)}
[data-theme^="mc-"] .nav-i.active{box-shadow:var(--bevel)}
[data-theme^="mc-"] .nav-i.active::before{background:#8ec44a}

.tree .nav-empty{padding:6px 8px;font-size:12px;color:var(--muted);text-align:center}

/* 侧栏底部工具 — 紧凑 */
.tools{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:4px}
.tools button{padding:5px 3px;font-size:11px;font-family:inherit;color:var(--muted);background:var(--bg);border:1px solid var(--bd);border-radius:var(--r);cursor:pointer;box-shadow:var(--bevel);transition:all .15s}
.tools button:hover{color:var(--text);background:var(--bg3)}
.tools button:active{box-shadow:var(--bevel-in)}

.card{margin-bottom:6px;padding:8px 10px;background:var(--bg);border:1px solid var(--bd);border-radius:var(--r);font-size:11.5px;box-shadow:var(--bevel)}
[data-theme^="mc-"] .card{border:2px solid var(--bd2)}
.row{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px}
.dot{width:7px;height:7px;flex:none;border-radius:50%;background:var(--muted);transition:background .3s}
[data-theme^="mc-"] .dot{border-radius:0}
.dot.on{background:var(--ok);box-shadow:0 0 0 2px rgba(26,127,55,.15)}
.dot.busy{background:var(--ac);box-shadow:0 0 0 2px var(--acs);animation:pls 1s infinite}
.dot.cool{background:var(--warn);box-shadow:0 0 0 2px rgba(212,167,44,.2)}
@keyframes pls{0%,100%{opacity:1}50%{opacity:.35}}
.cname{flex:1;min-width:0;font-weight:650;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap;font-size:11.5px}
.cx{width:20px;height:20px;flex:none;display:grid;place-items:center;font-size:11px;color:var(--muted);background:none;border:none;border-radius:3px;cursor:pointer;transition:all .15s}
.cx:hover{background:var(--bg3);color:var(--text);transform:rotate(60deg)}
.csub{margin-top:2px;font-size:10.5px;color:var(--muted)}
.cacts{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:4px;margin-top:6px}
.cacts button{padding:4px 3px;font-size:10.5px;font-family:inherit;color:var(--muted);background:var(--bg2);border:1px solid var(--bd);border-radius:calc(var(--r) - 1px);cursor:pointer;box-shadow:var(--bevel);transition:all .15s}
.cacts button:hover:not(:disabled){color:var(--ac);border-color:var(--ac);background:var(--acs)}
.cacts button:disabled{opacity:.6;cursor:not-allowed}
.cacts button.cooling{color:var(--warn);border-color:var(--warn);font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}

/* ==================== 内容区 — 紧凑 ==================== */
.content{position:relative;z-index:1;margin-left:0;padding:64px 24px 60px;min-height:100vh;transition:padding .3s}
.view{animation:viewIn .35s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1) both}
@keyframes viewIn{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(8px)}to{opacity:1;transform:none}}

/* Hero — 紧凑 */
.hero{padding:12px 0 20px;text-align:center;max-width:780px;margin:0 auto}
.hero-title{margin:0 0 6px;font-size:clamp(1.6rem,3.5vw,2.4rem);font-weight:800;line-height:1.15;letter-spacing:-.02em;
  background:var(--hero-grad);-webkit-background-clip:text;background-clip:text;-webkit-text-fill-color:transparent}
.hero-sub{margin:0 auto 14px;max-width:460px;font-size:13.5px;color:var(--muted);line-height:1.6}
.hero-stats{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px;justify-content:center}
.stat{display:flex;align-items:baseline;gap:4px;padding:4px 12px;background:var(--bg2);border:1px solid var(--bd);border-radius:999px;font-size:12px;color:var(--muted);box-shadow:var(--bevel)}
[data-theme^="mc-"] .stat{border-radius:2px;border:2px solid var(--bd2)}
.stat strong{color:var(--ac);font-size:14px;font-weight:800;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}

/* 主页随机小板块 — 紧凑 */
.home-random{margin:0 auto 20px;max-width:960px}
.section-label{font-size:11px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.08em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--muted);margin:0 0 8px 2px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:5px}
.section-label::before{content:"";display:inline-block;width:6px;height:6px;background:var(--ac);border-radius:2px;flex:none}
[data-theme^="mc-"] .section-label::before{border-radius:0}
.chip-row{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:8px}
.chip-block{position:relative;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:0;justify-content:center;padding:8px 12px;min-height:48px;background:var(--bg);border:1px solid var(--bd);border-radius:8px;cursor:pointer;text-decoration:none;color:inherit;overflow:hidden;box-shadow:0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,.03);transition:all .28s cubic-bezier(.34,1.56,.64,1);animation:tileIn .4s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1) both}
[data-theme^="mc-"] .chip-block{border:2px solid var(--bd2);border-radius:2px;box-shadow:var(--bevel)}
.chip-block::before{content:"";position:absolute;left:0;top:0;bottom:0;width:3px;background:var(--tile-accent);transition:width .25s}
.chip-block:hover{transform:translateY(-3px);box-shadow:0 8px 16px rgba(0,0,0,.1);border-color:var(--ac)}
[data-theme^="mc-"] .chip-block:hover{transform:none;box-shadow:var(--bevel),0 0 0 2px rgba(142,196,74,.3)}
.chip-block:hover::before{width:5px}
.chip-block:active{transform:translateY(-1px) scale(.98)}
.cb-chapter{font-size:10px;font-weight:700;color:var(--muted);letter-spacing:.04em;text-transform:uppercase;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap;transition:color .2s}
.cb-name{font-size:13px;font-weight:700;line-height:1.25;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap;transition:color .2s}
.chip-block:hover .cb-name{color:var(--ac)}
[data-theme^="mc-"] .chip-block:hover .cb-name{color:#2a3a1a}
.chip-empty{grid-column:1/-1;text-align:center;padding:14px;color:var(--muted);font-size:12px}

/* 大板块网格 — 紧凑 + 图标可编辑 */
.chapter-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(240px,1fr));gap:10px;max-width:960px;margin:0 auto}
.chapter-tile{position:relative;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;padding:12px 14px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--bg2),var(--bg));border:1px solid var(--bd);border-radius:10px;cursor:pointer;text-decoration:none;color:inherit;overflow:hidden;box-shadow:0 1px 4px rgba(0,0,0,.04);transition:all .3s cubic-bezier(.34,1.56,.64,1);animation:tileIn .45s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1) both}
[data-theme^="mc-"] .chapter-tile{border:2px solid var(--bd2);border-radius:2px;box-shadow:var(--bevel)}
.chapter-tile::before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;background:var(--tile-accent);opacity:.05;transition:opacity .3s;pointer-events:none}
[data-theme^="mc-"] .chapter-tile::before{display:none}
.chapter-tile:hover{transform:translateY(-4px);box-shadow:0 12px 24px rgba(0,0,0,.1);border-color:var(--ac)}
[data-theme^="mc-"] .chapter-tile:hover{transform:none;box-shadow:var(--bevel),0 0 0 2px rgba(142,196,74,.3)}
.chapter-tile:hover::before{opacity:.1}
.ct-icon{flex:none;width:44px;height:44px;display:grid;place-items:center;font-size:22px;background:var(--bg);border:1px solid var(--bd);border-radius:10px;transition:transform .35s cubic-bezier(.34,1.56,.64,1);cursor:pointer;position:relative}
[data-theme^="mc-"] .ct-icon{border:2px solid var(--bd2);border-radius:2px;box-shadow:var(--bevel)}
.ct-icon:hover{border-color:var(--ac);background:var(--acs)}
.chapter-tile:hover .ct-icon{transform:scale(1.06)}
.ct-icon .edit-hint{position:absolute;bottom:-1px;right:-1px;width:14px;height:14px;display:grid;place-items:center;font-size:8px;background:var(--ac);color:#fff;border-radius:50%;opacity:0;transition:opacity .2s;pointer-events:none}
[data-theme^="mc-"] .ct-icon .edit-hint{border-radius:0;border:1px solid var(--bd2)}
.ct-icon:hover .edit-hint{opacity:1}
.ct-info{flex:1;min-width:0}
.ct-name{font-size:16px;font-weight:800;line-height:1.2;letter-spacing:-.01em;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap;transition:color .2s;margin-bottom:2px}
[data-theme^="mc-"] .ct-name{color:#2a3a1a;text-shadow:1px 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.4)}
[data-theme="mc-night"] .ct-name{color:#e8ffd0;text-shadow:1px 1px 0 rgba(0,0,0,.4)}
.chapter-tile:hover .ct-name{color:var(--ac)}
[data-theme^="mc-"] .chapter-tile:hover .ct-name{color:#1a2a0a}
.ct-meta{font-size:11px;color:var(--muted);display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:2px 8px}
.ct-meta span{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:2px}
.ct-arrow{flex:none;font-size:18px;color:var(--ac);opacity:0;transform:translateX(-8px);transition:all .3s cubic-bezier(.34,1.56,.64,1);font-weight:700}
.chapter-tile:hover .ct-arrow{opacity:1;transform:translateX(0)}

/* 图标选择面板 */
.icon-picker{position:fixed;inset:0;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:16px;background:rgba(0,0,0,.5);backdrop-filter:blur(3px);z-index:120;opacity:0;visibility:hidden;transition:opacity .2s,visibility .2s}
.icon-picker.show{opacity:1;visibility:visible}
.icon-picker .ip-panel{background:var(--bg);border:2px solid var(--bd2);border-radius:var(--r);box-shadow:var(--sh);padding:14px;max-width:380px;width:100%}
[data-theme^="mc-"] .icon-picker .ip-panel{box-shadow:4px 4px 0 rgba(0,0,0,.3)}
.icon-picker .ip-title{font-size:13px;font-weight:700;margin:0 0 10px;color:var(--text)}
.icon-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(8,1fr);gap:4px}
.icon-grid button{aspect-ratio:1;display:grid;place-items:center;font-size:18px;background:var(--bg2);border:1px solid var(--bd);border-radius:var(--r);cursor:pointer;transition:all .15s}
.icon-grid button:hover{background:var(--acs);border-color:var(--ac);transform:scale(1.1)}
[data-theme^="mc-"] .icon-grid button{border:2px solid var(--bd2);border-radius:2px}
.icon-grid button.selected{border-color:var(--ac);background:var(--acs);box-shadow:0 0 0 2px var(--acs)}

.home-empty{text-align:center;padding:40px 16px;color:var(--muted);font-size:13px;line-height:1.8}
.home-empty .ic{font-size:36px;opacity:.5;margin-bottom:8px}

@keyframes tileIn{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(16px) scale(.95)}to{opacity:1;transform:none}}

/* ==================== 文章 — 紧凑 ==================== */
.art{max-width:760px;margin:0 auto}
.art h1{margin:0 0 4px;font-size:1.6rem;line-height:1.25;letter-spacing:-.02em;padding-bottom:0;border-bottom:var(--h1-border);animation:fadeUp .35s both}
[data-theme^="mc-"] .art h1{color:#2a3a1a;padding-bottom:8px;margin-bottom:12px;text-shadow:1px 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.4)}
[data-theme="mc-night"] .art h1{color:#e8ffd0;text-shadow:1px 1px 0 rgba(0,0,0,.4)}
@keyframes fadeUp{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(6px)}to{opacity:1;transform:none}}
.art .meta{margin-bottom:18px;padding-bottom:12px;font-size:12px;color:var(--muted);border-bottom:1px solid var(--bd);animation:fadeUp .35s .04s both}
[data-theme^="mc-"] .art .meta{border-bottom:1px dashed #a8a89a}
.art .meta .edit{float:right;color:var(--ac);cursor:pointer;text-decoration:none;font-weight:600;font-size:12px}
.art .meta .bread{color:var(--muted);font-size:11.5px}
.art .meta .bread b{color:var(--ac);font-weight:600}
.art .ab{animation:fadeUp .4s .08s both;font-size:14.5px}
.ab h2{margin:24px 0 10px;padding:0 0 5px;font-size:1.15rem;border-bottom:1px solid var(--bd);background:var(--h2-bg);color:var(--h2-fg)}
[data-theme^="mc-"] .ab h2{padding:6px 12px;border:2px solid var(--bd2);border-radius:2px;font-size:1.05rem;text-shadow:1px 1px 0 rgba(0,0,0,.3);box-shadow:var(--bevel);margin:20px 0 10px}
.ab h3{margin:18px 0 6px;font-size:1rem}
[data-theme^="mc-"] .ab h3{color:var(--ac);border-bottom:1px solid var(--bd);padding-bottom:3px}
.ab p{margin:0 0 12px}
.ab ul,.ab ol{margin:0 0 12px;padding-left:1.4em}
.ab li{margin:3px 0}
.ab a{color:var(--ac);font-weight:500}
.ab code{padding:.12em .35em;font-family:ui-monospace,Menlo,Consolas,monospace;font-size:.85em;background:var(--cbg);border-radius:3px;border:1px solid var(--bd)}
[data-theme^="mc-"] .ab code{background:#f0ecd8;border:1px solid #a8a89a;border-radius:2px}
.ab pre{margin:0 0 14px;padding:10px 12px;overflow-x:auto;background:var(--cbg);border:1px solid var(--bd);border-radius:var(--r)}
[data-theme^="mc-"] .ab pre{border:2px solid #a8a89a;border-radius:2px;box-shadow:var(--bevel-in);background:#f0ecd8}
[data-theme="mc-night"] .ab pre{background:#1a1a1a}
.ab pre code{padding:0;font-size:12.5px;background:none;border:none}
.ab table{width:100%;margin:0 0 14px;border-collapse:collapse;font-size:13.5px}
.ab th,.ab td{padding:6px 10px;text-align:left;border:1px solid var(--bd)}
.ab th{background:var(--bg2);font-weight:650}
[data-theme^="mc-"] .ab th{background:linear-gradient(180deg,#e0e8d0,#c8d4a8);border:2px solid #a8a89a;text-align:center}
[data-theme^="mc-"] .ab td{border:2px solid #c8c4b0}
.ab tbody tr:hover{background:var(--bg2)}
.ab> :first-child{margin-top:0}
.callout{display:flex;gap:8px;margin:0 0 14px;padding:10px 12px;font-size:13.5px;background:var(--bg2);border:1px solid var(--bd);border-left:3px solid var(--ac);border-radius:var(--r);transition:transform .2s}
.callout::before{content:"💡"}
.callout:hover{transform:translateX(2px)}
[data-theme^="mc-"] .callout{border:2px solid #a8a89a;border-left:3px solid var(--ac);border-radius:2px;box-shadow:var(--bevel)}
.callout p:last-child{margin-bottom:0}

/* 文章内目录 — MC Wiki 风格 */
.article-toc{margin:0 0 16px;padding:10px 14px;background:var(--bg2);border:1px solid var(--bd);border-radius:var(--r);font-size:12.5px;animation:fadeUp .35s .06s both}
[data-theme^="mc-"] .article-toc{border:2px solid var(--bd2);border-radius:2px;box-shadow:var(--bevel)}
.article-toc .toc-title{font-weight:700;font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.06em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--muted);margin-bottom:6px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:4px}
.article-toc .toc-title::before{content:"📑";font-size:12px}
.article-toc ul{margin:0;padding-left:1.3em;list-style:none}
.article-toc li{margin:2px 0;position:relative}
.article-toc li::before{content:"▸";position:absolute;left:-1.1em;color:var(--ac);font-size:10px;opacity:.7}
.article-toc a{color:var(--text);text-decoration:none;transition:color .15s}
.article-toc a:hover{color:var(--ac);text-decoration:underline}

/* 上一篇/下一篇 — MC Wiki 风格紧凑 */
.tile-nav{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr auto 1fr;gap:10px;margin-top:28px;padding-top:18px;border-top:1px solid var(--bd);max-width:760px;margin-left:auto;margin-right:auto}
[data-theme^="mc-"] .tile-nav{border-top:2px solid var(--bd)}
.tile-nav .nav-tile{position:relative;display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:center;gap:2px;min-height:60px;padding:10px 12px;background:var(--bg);border:1px solid var(--bd);border-radius:8px;cursor:pointer;overflow:hidden;text-decoration:none;color:inherit;box-shadow:0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,.03);transition:all .28s cubic-bezier(.34,1.56,.64,1)}
[data-theme^="mc-"] .tile-nav .nav-tile{border-radius:2px;border:2px solid var(--bd2);box-shadow:var(--bevel)}
.tile-nav .nav-tile:hover{transform:translateY(-3px);box-shadow:0 8px 16px rgba(0,0,0,.08);border-color:var(--ac)}
[data-theme^="mc-"] .tile-nav .nav-tile:hover{transform:none;box-shadow:var(--bevel),0 0 0 2px rgba(142,196,74,.3)}
.tile-nav .nav-label{font-size:10.5px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.05em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--muted);display:flex;align-items:center;gap:4px}
.tile-nav .nav-title{font-size:13px;font-weight:700;line-height:1.3;color:var(--text);display:-webkit-box;-webkit-line-clamp:2;-webkit-box-orient:vertical;overflow:hidden}
[data-theme^="mc-"] .tile-nav .nav-title{color:#2a3a1a}
[data-theme="mc-night"] .tile-nav .nav-title{color:#e8ffd0}
.tile-nav .nav-tile.next{text-align:right}
.tile-nav .nav-tile.next .nav-label{justify-content:flex-end}
.tile-nav .nav-arrow{display:inline-block;transition:transform .25s cubic-bezier(.34,1.56,.64,1);font-size:12px}
.tile-nav .nav-tile.prev:hover .nav-arrow{transform:translateX(-3px)}
.tile-nav .nav-tile.next:hover .nav-arrow{transform:translateX(3px)}
.tile-nav .nav-tile.home{width:64px;height:64px;min-height:0;align-items:center;justify-content:center;text-align:center;padding:8px}
.tile-nav .nav-tile.home .home-icon{font-size:20px;line-height:1;transition:transform .3s cubic-bezier(.34,1.56,.64,1)}
.tile-nav .nav-tile.home:hover .home-icon{transform:scale(1.1) rotate(-6deg)}
.tile-nav .nav-tile.home .nav-label{justify-content:center;font-size:10px;margin-top:2px}
.tile-nav .nav-tile.disabled{opacity:.35;pointer-events:none;cursor:default}

/* ==================== 弹窗 ==================== */
.ov{position:fixed;inset:0;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:16px;background:rgba(0,0,0,.5);backdrop-filter:blur(3px);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(3px);z-index:100;opacity:0;visibility:hidden;transition:opacity .2s,visibility .2s}
.ov.show{opacity:1;visibility:visible}
.pnl{display:flex;flex-direction:column;width:100%;max-width:960px;height:100%;max-height:720px;background:var(--bg);border:1px solid var(--bd);border-radius:calc(var(--r) + 3px);box-shadow:var(--sh);overflow:hidden;transform:translateY(16px) scale(.97);transition:transform .28s cubic-bezier(.34,1.56,.64,1)}
[data-theme^="mc-"] .pnl{border:2px solid var(--bd2);border-radius:2px;box-shadow:3px 3px 0 rgba(0,0,0,.3)}
.ov.show .pnl{transform:none}
.pnl.sm{max-width:500px;height:auto;max-height:calc(100vh - 32px)}
.ph{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;padding:10px 14px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--bd)}
[data-theme^="mc-"] .ph{background:linear-gradient(180deg,#7a9c3c,#56682c);color:#fff;border-bottom:2px solid #3d521f;text-shadow:1px 1px 0 rgba(0,0,0,.3);padding:8px 14px}
[data-theme="mc-night"] .ph{background:linear-gradient(180deg,#5a7a2c,#3d521f);color:#e8ffd0;border-bottom-color:#2a3a1a}
.ph strong{font-size:14px}
.ph .sp{flex:1}
[data-theme^="mc-"] .ph .icon{color:#fff}
[data-theme^="mc-"] .ph .icon:hover{background:rgba(0,0,0,.2)}
.pf{display:flex;gap:10px;padding:10px 14px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--bd)}
.pf-3{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr 1fr;gap:10px;padding:10px 14px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--bd)}
.fld{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:3px;flex:1}
.fld span{font-size:10.5px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.04em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--muted)}
.fld input,.fld select{height:30px;padding:0 8px;font-size:13px;font-family:inherit;color:var(--text);background:var(--bg2);border:1px solid var(--bd);border-radius:calc(var(--r) - 1px);outline:none;transition:border-color .2s,box-shadow .2s}
[data-theme^="mc-"] .fld input,[data-theme^="mc-"] .fld select{border:2px solid var(--bd2);border-radius:2px;box-shadow:var(--bevel-in)}
.fld input:focus,.fld select:focus{border-color:var(--ac);box-shadow:0 0 0 2px var(--acs)}
.tb{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:3px;padding:6px 14px;background:var(--bg2);border-bottom:1px solid var(--bd)}
[data-theme^="mc-"] .tb{background:#e8e2cc;border-bottom:1px solid #a8a89a}
.tb button{min-width:28px;height:26px;padding:0 6px;font-size:12px;font-family:ui-monospace,Menlo,Consolas,monospace;color:var(--muted);background:var(--bg);border:1px solid var(--bd);border-radius:calc(var(--r) - 2px);cursor:pointer;box-shadow:var(--bevel);transition:all .15s}
.tb button:hover{color:var(--ac);border-color:var(--ac);background:var(--acs)}
.pmain{display:flex;gap:10px;flex:1;min-height:0;padding:10px 14px}
.pmain textarea{flex:1;min-width:0;padding:10px 12px;font-family:ui-monospace,Menlo,Consolas,monospace;font-size:12.5px;line-height:1.6;color:var(--text);background:var(--bg2);border:1px solid var(--bd);border-radius:var(--r);resize:none;outline:none;tab-size:2;transition:border-color .2s,box-shadow .2s}
[data-theme^="mc-"] .pmain textarea{border:2px solid var(--bd2);border-radius:2px;box-shadow:var(--bevel-in);background:#f0ecd8}
[data-theme="mc-night"] .pmain textarea{background:#1a1a1a}
.pmain textarea:focus{border-color:var(--ac);box-shadow:0 0 0 2px var(--acs)}
.pprev{flex:1;min-width:0;padding:10px 12px;overflow-y:auto;background:var(--bg);border:1px solid var(--bd);border-radius:var(--r);display:none;font-size:14px}
[data-theme^="mc-"] .pprev{border:2px solid var(--bd2);border-radius:2px}
.pmain.pv .pprev{display:block}
.pfoot{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;padding:10px 14px;border-top:1px solid var(--bd)}
.pfoot .sp{flex:1}
.phint{font-size:11px;color:var(--muted)}

.ghb{padding:14px;overflow-y:auto}
.ghb .fld+.fld{margin-top:10px}
.ghh{margin-top:10px;padding:8px 10px;font-size:11.5px;line-height:1.5;color:var(--muted);background:var(--bg2);border:1px solid var(--bd);border-radius:calc(var(--r) - 1px)}
[data-theme^="mc-"] .ghh{border:2px solid var(--bd2);border-radius:2px}
.ghh a{color:var(--ac)}

.theme-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:10px;padding:14px}
.theme-card{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:8px;padding:12px;background:var(--bg2);border:2px solid var(--bd);border-radius:var(--r);cursor:pointer;font-family:inherit;color:var(--text);box-shadow:var(--bevel);transition:all .2s;text-align:left}
.theme-card:hover{transform:translateY(-2px);border-color:var(--ac)}
.theme-card.active{border-color:var(--ac);box-shadow:var(--bevel),0 0 0 2px var(--acs)}
.theme-prev{display:flex;height:30px;border:1px solid var(--bd);border-radius:calc(var(--r) - 2px);overflow:hidden}
.theme-prev span{flex:1;display:block}
.theme-name{font-size:12.5px;font-weight:700}
.theme-desc{font-size:10.5px;color:var(--muted);margin-top:-3px}

.tag-list{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:6px;padding:12px 14px;overflow-y:auto;flex:1;max-height:55vh}
.tag-item{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;padding:8px 10px;background:var(--bg2);border:1px solid var(--bd);border-radius:var(--r);box-shadow:var(--bevel)}
.tag-item .name{flex:1;min-width:0;font-weight:600;font-size:13px;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap;padding:2px 4px}
.tag-item .cnt{flex:none;font-size:10.5px;color:var(--muted);padding:1px 6px;background:var(--bg3);border-radius:8px;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
.tag-empty{padding:30px 16px;text-align:center;color:var(--muted);font-size:12.5px}
.tag-group-label{padding:4px 2px 1px;font-size:10.5px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.05em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--muted)}
.tag-group-label .tag-path{font-size:10px;color:var(--muted);font-weight:500;letter-spacing:0;text-transform:none;margin-left:3px}

.toast{position:fixed;left:50%;bottom:20px;max-width:calc(100vw - 32px);padding:8px 16px;font-size:13px;color:var(--bg);background:var(--text);border-radius:var(--r);box-shadow:var(--sh);opacity:0;transform:translateX(-50%) translateY(16px);transition:opacity .22s,transform .28s cubic-bezier(.34,1.56,.64,1);pointer-events:none;z-index:200}
[data-theme^="mc-"] .toast{background:#2a3a1a;color:#e8ffd0;border:2px solid #4a4a3a;border-radius:2px;box-shadow:2px 2px 0 rgba(0,0,0,.4)}
.toast.show{opacity:1;transform:translateX(-50%) translateY(0)}

.bd{position:fixed;inset:46px 0 0 0;background:rgba(0,0,0,.4);opacity:0;visibility:hidden;transition:opacity .2s,visibility .2s;z-index:35}
.bd.show{opacity:1;visibility:visible}

/* ==================== 响应式 ==================== */
@media(min-width:901px){
  body.sidebar-open .content{margin-left:var(--sidebar-w)}
  body.sidebar-open .bd{opacity:0!important;visibility:hidden!important}
}
@media(max-width:1100px){.chapter-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(220px,1fr))}}
@media(max-width:900px){
  .sidebar{width:260px}
  body.sidebar-open .content{margin-left:0}
  .content{padding:56px 16px 48px}
  .art h1{font-size:1.35rem}
  .chapter-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:8px}
  .chip-row{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:6px}
  .ov{padding:0}
  .pnl{max-height:none;border-radius:0;border:none}
  .pnl.sm{max-height:none}
  .pmain{flex-direction:column}
  .pf{flex-direction:column;gap:6px}
  .pf-3{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:6px}
  .phint{display:none}
  .blob{filter:blur(60px)}
  .b1,.b2{width:300px;height:300px}
  .theme-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}
}
@media(max-width:560px){
  .search input{font-size:12px}
  .hero{padding:8px 0 16px}
  .hero-sub{font-size:12px}
  .stat{padding:3px 10px;font-size:11px}
  .tile-nav{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}
  .tile-nav .nav-tile.home{width:100%;height:auto;min-height:48px;grid-column:span 2;flex-direction:row;gap:8px}
  .tile-nav .nav-tile.home .home-icon{font-size:16px}
  .tile-nav .nav-tile.home .nav-label{margin:0;font-size:10px}
  .icon-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(6,1fr)}
}
@media print{.topbar,.sidebar,.bd,.tile-nav,.ov,.toast,.bg-decor,#progress,.home-random{display:none}.content{margin:0;padding:0}}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){*,*::before,*::after{animation-duration:.01ms!important;animation-iteration-count:1!important;transition-duration:.01ms!important;scroll-behavior:auto!important}}
</style>

<body>

<div class="bg-decor" aria-hidden="true">
  <div class="blob b1"></div>
  <div class="blob b2"></div>
  <div class="blob b3"></div>
  <div class="grid-bg"></div>
  <canvas id="particles"></canvas>
</div>

<div id="progress"></div>
<div id="boot"><span class="spin"></span>正在加载内容…</div>

<!-- 顶栏 -->
<header class="topbar" hidden>
  <button class="icon menu" id="menuBtn" title="目录（Ctrl+B）">
    <svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.2" stroke-linecap="round">
      <line x1="3" y1="6" x2="21" y2="6"/><line x1="3" y1="12" x2="21" y2="12"/><line x1="3" y1="18" x2="21" y2="18"/>
    </svg>

  <a class="logo" href="#" id="logoLink"><span class="logo-icon">🧱</span><span>红石的答辩wiki</span></a>
  <div class="search">
    <svg width="14" height="14" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round"><circle cx="11" cy="11" r="7"/><path d="m20 20-3.5-3.5"/></svg>
    <input id="search" type="search" placeholder="搜索…（按 / 聚焦）" autocomplete="off">

</header>

<!-- 侧边栏 -->
<aside class="sidebar" id="sidebar">
  <div class="sidebar-head">
    <span class="stitle">目录</span>
    <button class="icon" id="sidebarClose" title="收起（Ctrl+B）">◀</button>
  </div>
  <div class="sidebar-body">
    <nav class="tree" id="navList"></nav>
  </div>
  <div class="sidebar-foot">
    <div class="card" id="cloudCard">
      <div class="row">
        <span class="dot" id="cloudDot"></span>
        <span class="cname" id="cloudName">数据源</span>
        <button class="cx admin-only" id="cloudCfgBtn" title="管理员配置" hidden>⚙</button>
      </div>
      <div class="csub" id="cloudSub">加载中…</div>
      <div class="cacts admin-only" id="cloudActs" hidden>
        <button id="btnPush">⬆ 推送</button>
        <button id="btnPull">⬇ 拉取</button>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div class="tools">
      <button id="btnHome">🏠 主页</button>
      <button id="btnExport">⬇ 导出</button>
      <button class="admin-only" id="btnTags" hidden style="grid-column:span 2">🏷️ 结构总览</button>
    </div>
  </div>

<div class="bd" id="bd"></div>

<!-- 主内容 -->

function $(id){return document.getElementById(id);}
function stripTags(h){return String(h==null?'':h).replace(/<[^>]*>/g,' ').replace(/\s+/g,' ').trim();}
function esc(s){return String(s==null?'':s).replace(/[&<>"']/g,function(c){return {'&':'&','<':'<','>':'>','"':'"',"'":'''}[c];});}
function slug(t){var s=String(t||'').toLowerCase().replace(/[^\w\u4e00-\u9fa5]+/g,'-').replace(/^-+|-+$/g,'');return s||'entry';}
function uniqId(t,used){
  var set=used||new Set(articles.map(function(a){return a.id;}));
  var b=slug(t),id=b,n=2;
  while(set.has(id)){id=b+'-'+n;n++;}
  set.add(id);return id;
}
function normList(arr){
  if(!Array.isArray(arr))return [];
  var used=new Set(),out=[];
  arr.forEach(function(r,i){
    if(!r||typeof r!=='object')return;
    var t=(typeof r.title==='string'&&r.title.trim())?r.title.trim():('未命名 '+(i+1));
    var id=String(r.id||'').trim();
    if(!id||used.has(id))id=uniqId(t,used);else used.add(id);
    out.push({
      id:id,title:t,
      chapter:(typeof r.chapter==='string'&&r.chapter.trim())?r.chapter.trim():'未分类大板块',
      section:(typeof r.section==='string'&&r.section.trim())?r.section.trim():'未分类板块',
      category:(typeof r.category==='string'&&r.category.trim())?r.category.trim():'未分类',
      content:typeof r.content==='string'?r.content:''
    });
  });
  return out;
}
function parseList(text){
  var p=JSON.parse(text);
  if(!Array.isArray(p))throw new Error('顶层必须是数组');
  return normList(p);
}
function b64enc(s){
  var b=new TextEncoder().encode(String(s)),bin='';
  for(var i=0;i<b.length;i++)bin+=String.fromCharCode(b[i]);
  return btoa(bin);
}
function b64dec(b64){
  var bin=atob(String(b64).replace(/\s/g,''));
  var bytes=new Uint8Array(bin.length);
  for(var i=0;i<bin.length;i++)bytes[i]=bin.charCodeAt(i);
  return new TextDecoder().decode(bytes);
}

var particleCtx=null,particles=[],particleRunning=true,pW=0,pH=0,pDpr=1;
function getParticleColors(){
  var t=document.documentElement.getAttribute('data-theme');
  if(t==='mc-wiki')return ['61,82,31','106,140,60','140,180,60'];
  if(t==='mc-night')return ['142,196,74','90,140,60','200,180,100'];
  if(t==='github-dark')return ['68,147,248','163,113,247','230,237,243'];
  return ['9,105,218','163,113,247','31,35,40'];
}
function initParticles(){
  var canvas=$('particles');if(!canvas||!canvas.getContext)return;
  particleCtx=canvas.getContext('2d');
  pDpr=Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio||1,2);
  resizeCanvas();
  var count=Math.max(10,Math.min(28,Math.floor((pW*pH)/50000)));
  particles=[];
  for(var i=0;i<count;i++){
    particles.push({
      x:Math.random()*pW,y:Math.random()*pH,size:2+Math.random()*5,
      vx:(Math.random()-0.5)*0.3,vy:(Math.random()-0.5)*0.3,
      rot:Math.random()*Math.PI,vr:(Math.random()-0.5)*0.007,
      alpha:0.04+Math.random()*0.1,hueIdx:i%3
    });
  }
  if(particleRunning)drawParticles();
}
function resizeCanvas(){
  var canvas=$('particles');if(!canvas)return;
  pW=window.innerWidth;pH=window.innerHeight;
  canvas.width=pW*pDpr;canvas.height=pH*pDpr;
  canvas.style.width=pW+'px';canvas.style.height=pH+'px';
  if(particleCtx)particleCtx.setTransform(pDpr,0,0,pDpr,0,0);
}
function drawParticles(){
  if(!particleRunning||!particleCtx)return;
  var colors=getParticleColors();
  particleCtx.clearRect(0,0,pW,pH);
  for(var i=0;i<particles.length;i++){
    var p=particles[i];
    p.x+=p.vx;p.y+=p.vy;p.rot+=p.vr;
    if(p.x<-30)p.x=pW+30;else if(p.x>pW+30)p.x=-30;
    if(p.y<-30)p.y=pH+30;else if(p.y>pH+30)p.y=-30;
    particleCtx.save();
    particleCtx.translate(p.x,p.y);particleCtx.rotate(p.rot);
    particleCtx.fillStyle='rgba('+colors[p.hueIdx]+','+p.alpha+')';
    var s=p.size,hs=s/2,r=Math.min(2,s/3);
    particleCtx.beginPath();
    if(particleCtx.roundRect)particleCtx.roundRect(-hs,-hs,s,s,r);else particleCtx.rect(-hs,-hs,s,s);
    particleCtx.fill();particleCtx.restore();
  }
  requestAnimationFrame(drawParticles);
}

function cooldownLeft(){return Math.max(0,cooldownUntil-Date.now());}
function inCooldown(){return cooldownLeft()>0;}
function startCooldown(){

  updateCooldownUI();
  cooldownTimer=setInterval(function(){
    if(!inCooldown()){clearInterval(cooldownTimer);cooldownTimer=null;}
    updateCooldownUI();
  },500);
}
function updateCooldownUI(){
  var left=cooldownLeft(),secs=Math.ceil(left/1000);
  if(left>0){

function ghHeaders(){return {'Authorization':'Bearer '+(gh?gh.token:''),'Accept':'application/vnd.github+json','X-GitHub-Api-Version':'2022-11-28'};}

function loadPublic(){
  return fetch(rawUrl()+'?t='+Date.now(),{cache:'no-store'})
    .then(function(r){if(!r.ok)throw new Error('HTTP '+r.status);return r.text();})
    .then(parseList)
    .catch(function(){
      return fetch(cdnUrl()+'?t='+Date.now())
        .then(function(r){if(!r.ok)throw new Error('HTTP '+r.status);return r.text();})
        .then(parseList);
    });
}
function loadAdmin(){
  return fetch(apiUrl()+'?ref='+encodeURIComponent(GH_BRANCH),{headers:ghHeaders()})
    .then(function(r){
      if(r.status===404)return [];
      if(!r.ok)return r.json().catch(function(){return{};}).then(function(e){throw new Error(e.message||('HTTP '+r.status));});
      return r.json();
    })
    .then(function(info){
      if(Array.isArray(info))return [];
      return parseList(b64dec(info.content||''));
    });
}
function pushCloud(silent){
  if(!gh||!gh.token){return Promise.resolve(false);}
  if(inCooldown()){
    if(!silent)toast('冷却中，请 '+Math.ceil(cooldownLeft()/1000)+' 秒后再试');
    return Promise.resolve(false);
  }
  if(ghBusy)return Promise.resolve(false);
  ghBusy=true;updateCloudUI();
  return fetch(apiUrl()+'?ref='+encodeURIComponent(GH_BRANCH),{headers:ghHeaders()})
    .then(function(r){
      if(r.status===404)return null;
      if(!r.ok)return r.json().catch(function(){return{};}).then(function(e){throw new Error(e.message||('HTTP '+r.status));});
      return r.json();
    })
    .then(function(info){
      var body={message:'更新 wiki 数据 '+new Date().toISOString().slice(0,19).replace('T',' '),
        content:b64enc(JSON.stringify(articles,null,2)),branch:GH_BRANCH};
      if(info&&info.sha)body.sha=info.sha;
      var h=ghHeaders();h['Content-Type']='application/json';
      return fetch(apiUrl(),{method:'PUT',headers:h,body:JSON.stringify(body)})
        .then(function(r){
          if(!r.ok)return r.json().catch(function(){return{};}).then(function(e){throw new Error(e.message||('HTTP '+r.status));});
          return r.json();
        });
    })
    .then(function(){
      ghBusy=false;startCooldown();updateCloudUI();
      if(!silent)toast('已同步到云端 · 60 秒后可再次推送');
      return true;
    })
    .catch(function(err){
      ghBusy=false;updateCloudUI();
      if(!silent)toast('同步失败：'+err.message);
      return false;
    });
}

    else{state.currentId=null;showView('home');renderHome();}

}

  if(statArticles)statArticles.textContent=articles.length;
  if(statChapters)statChapters.textContent=Object.keys(chapters).length;
}

/* 目录树数据 */
var treeData=[];
function buildTreeData(){
  var chapters=new Map();
  articles.forEach(function(a){
    var ck=a.chapter;
    if(!chapters.has(ck))chapters.set(ck,{name:ck,sections:new Map(),count:0});
    var ch=chapters.get(ck);ch.count++;
    var sk=a.section;
    if(!ch.sections.has(sk))ch.sections.set(sk,{name:sk,cats:new Map(),count:0});
    var se=ch.sections.get(sk);se.count++;
    var cck=a.category;
    if(!se.cats.has(cck))se.cats.set(cck,{name:cck,items:[],count:0});
    var ca=se.cats.get(cck);ca.items.push(a);ca.count++;
  });
  treeData=[];
  chapters.forEach(function(ch){
    var secs=[];

    try{window.scrollTo(0,0);}catch(e){}
    return;
  }

  var found=articles.find(function(a){return a.id===id;});
  if(!found){
    if(articles.length===0){state.currentId=null;showView('home');renderHome();return;}
    try{history.replaceState(null,'',location.pathname+location.search);}catch(e){}

  if(!isDesktop())closeSidebar();
  try{window.scrollTo(0,0);}catch(e){}

}

    document.body.style.overflow='';
}
function openGh(){ghToken.value=gh?(gh.token||''):'';ghDisconn.hidden=!isAdmin;ghOv.classList.add('show');document.body.style.overflow='hidden';setTimeout(function(){try{ghToken.focus();}catch(e){}},40);}
function closeGh(){ghOv.classList.remove('show');if(!edOv.classList.contains('show')&&!tagOv.classList.contains('show')&&!themeOv.classList.contains('show')&&!iconPicker.classList.contains('show'))document.body.style.overflow='';}
function openTheme(){buildThemeGrid();themeOv.classList.add('show');document.body.style.overflow='hidden';}
function closeTheme(){themeOv.classList.remove('show');if(!edOv.classList.contains('show')&&!tagOv.classList.contains('show')&&!ghOv.classList.contains('show')&&!iconPicker.classList.contains('show'))document.body.style.overflow='';}

/* 事件绑定 */
function bind(){
  searchEl.addEventListener('input',function(e){
    state.query=e.target.value||'';
    if(state.view==='home')renderHome();
    renderNav();
  });

  menuBtn.addEventListener('click',toggleSidebar);
  if(sidebarClose)sidebarClose.addEventListener('click',function(){closeSidebar();storage.set(K_SIDEBAR,'closed');});
  bdEl.addEventListener('click',closeSidebar);

  themeBtn.addEventListener('click',openTheme);

  logoLink.addEventListener('click',function(e){
    e.preventDefault();
    try{history.pushState(null,'',location.pathname+location.search);}catch(err){}
    onHash();
  });

  editBtn.addEventListener('click',function(){
    var cur=articles.find(function(a){return a.id===state.currentId;});
    if(cur)openEditor(cur);
    else if(articles.length)openEditor(articles[0]);
    else openEditor(null);
  });
  newBtn.addEventListener('click',function(){
    var cur=articles.find(function(a){return a.id===state.currentId;});
    openEditor(null);
    if(cur){edChap.value=cur.chapter;edSec.value=cur.section;edC.value=cur.category;}
  });

  artEl.addEventListener('click',function(e){
    var el=e.target.closest('[data-action]');if(!el)return;
    var a=el.getAttribute('data-action');
    if(a==='edit'){
      var cur=articles.find(function(x){return x.id===state.currentId;});
      if(cur)openEditor(cur);
    }
  });

  tileNav.addEventListener('click',function(e){
    var homeBtn=e.target.closest('[data-nav="home"]');
    if(homeBtn){e.preventDefault();try{history.pushState(null,'',location.pathname+location.search);}catch(err){}onHash();}
  });

  edTb.addEventListener('click',function(e){
    var b=e.target.closest('button[data-t]');if(!b)return;
    var t=TOOLS[parseInt(b.getAttribute('data-t'),10)];
    if(t){wrapSel(t.w[0],t.w[1]);try{edContent.focus();}catch(err){}syncPreview();}
  });
  edContent.addEventListener('input',syncPreview);
  edContent.addEventListener('keydown',function(e){
    if(e.key!=='Tab')return;e.preventDefault();
    var ta=edContent;ta.setRangeText('  ',ta.selectionStart,ta.selectionEnd,'end');syncPreview();
  });
  edPrevBtn.addEventListener('click',function(){
    var on=edMain.classList.toggle('pv');edPrevBtn.classList.toggle('active',on);
    if(on)syncPreview();
  });
  edSave.addEventListener('click',saveEditor);
  edCancel.addEventListener('click',closeEditor);
  edClose.addEventListener('click',closeEditor);
  edDel.addEventListener('click',deleteCurrent);

  cloudCfgBtn.addEventListener('click',function(e){e.stopPropagation();openGh();});
  btnPush.addEventListener('click',function(){pushCloud(false);});
  btnPull.addEventListener('click',function(){
    if(!isAdmin)return;toast('正在拉取…');
    loadAdmin().then(function(list){applyArticles(list);toast('已拉取 '+list.length+' 个条目');})
      .catch(function(err){toast('拉取失败：'+err.message);});
  });
  btnExport.addEventListener('click',function(){
    if(articles.length===0){toast('还没有内容');return;}
    try{
      var blob=new Blob([JSON.stringify(articles,null,2)],{type:'application/json;charset=utf-8'});
      var url=URL.createObjectURL(blob);
      var a=document.createElement('a');a.href=url;a.download='wiki-'+new Date().toISOString().slice(0,10)+'.json';
      document.body.appendChild(a);a.click();document.body.removeChild(a);
      setTimeout(function(){URL.revokeObjectURL(url);},1000);
      toast('已导出 '+articles.length+' 个条目');
    }catch(err){alert('导出失败：'+err.message);}
  });
  btnTags.addEventListener('click',openTags);
  btnHome.addEventListener('click',function(){
    try{history.pushState(null,'',location.pathname+location.search);}catch(err){}
    onHash();
  });

  tagClose.addEventListener('click',closeTags);
  tagCancel.addEventListener('click',closeTags);

  ghClose.addEventListener('click',closeGh);
  ghCancel.addEventListener('click',closeGh);
  ghSave.addEventListener('click',function(){
    var token=ghToken.value.trim();
    if(!token){toast('请填 Token');return;}
    gh={token:token};storage.set(K_GH,JSON.stringify(gh));
    isAdmin=true;applyMode();updateCloudUI();closeGh();
    toast('已进入管理员模式，正在拉取…');
    loadAdmin().then(function(list){applyArticles(list);toast('已连接 · '+list.length+' 个条目');})
      .catch(function(err){toast('已连接，但拉取失败：'+err.message);});
  });
  ghDisconn.addEventListener('click',function(){
    if(!confirm('退出管理员模式？'))return;
    gh=null;isAdmin=false;storage.del(K_GH);
    applyMode();updateCloudUI();closeGh();
    toast('已退出管理员模式');
    loadPublic().then(applyArticles).catch(function(){});
  });

  themeClose.addEventListener('click',closeTheme);
  themeGrid.addEventListener('click',function(e){
    var card=e.target.closest('[data-theme-val]');if(!card)return;
    applyTheme(card.getAttribute('data-theme-val'));closeTheme();
  });

  [edOv,ghOv,themeOv,tagOv].forEach(function(ov){
    if(!ov)return;
    ov.addEventListener('click',function(e){
      if(e.target!==ov)return;
      if(ov===edOv)closeEditor();
      else if(ov===ghOv)closeGh();
      else if(ov===themeOv)closeTheme();
      else if(ov===tagOv)closeTags();
    });
  });

  document.addEventListener('keydown',function(e){
    if(edOv.classList.contains('show')){
      if(e.key==='Escape'){e.preventDefault();closeEditor();}
      else if((e.metaKey||e.ctrlKey)&&e.key.toLowerCase()==='s'){e.preventDefault();saveEditor();}
      return;
    }
    if(iconPicker.classList.contains('show')){if(e.key==='Escape'){e.preventDefault();closeIconPicker();}return;}
    if(ghOv.classList.contains('show')){if(e.key==='Escape'){e.preventDefault();closeGh();}return;}
    if(themeOv.classList.contains('show')){if(e.key==='Escape'){e.preventDefault();closeTheme();}return;}
    if(tagOv.classList.contains('show')){if(e.key==='Escape'){e.preventDefault();closeTags();}return;}

    var tag=document.activeElement&&document.activeElement.tagName;
    var typing=tag==='INPUT'||tag==='TEXTAREA'||tag==='SELECT';

    if((e.metaKey||e.ctrlKey)&&e.key.toLowerCase()==='b'){e.preventDefault();toggleSidebar();return;}

    if(e.key==='/'&&!typing){e.preventDefault();searchEl.focus();searchEl.select();return;}
    if(e.key==='Escape'){
      if(document.activeElement===searchEl&&(searchEl.value||state.query)){
        searchEl.value='';state.query='';
        if(state.view==='home')renderHome();
        renderNav();
      }else{try{searchEl.blur();}catch(err){}closeSidebar();}
      return;
    }
    if(!typing&&!e.metaKey&&!e.ctrlKey&&!e.altKey){
      var k=e.key.toLowerCase();
      if(k==='e'){e.preventDefault();editBtn.click();}
      else if(k==='n'){e.preventDefault();newBtn.click();}
      else if(k==='h'){e.preventDefault();try{history.pushState(null,'',location.pathname+location.search);}catch(err){}onHash();}
    }
  });

  window.addEventListener('beforeunload',function(e){
    if(edOv.classList.contains('show')){e.preventDefault();e.returnValue='';}
  });

  window.addEventListener('scroll',onScroll,{passive:true});
  window.addEventListener('resize',function(){
    resizeCanvas();onScroll();
    if(isDesktop())bdEl.classList.remove('show');
  },{passive:true});
  document.addEventListener('visibilitychange',function(){
    particleRunning=!document.hidden;
    if(particleRunning)drawParticles();
  });

  window.addEventListener('popstate',onHash);
}

function boot(){
  try{
    if(bootEl&&bootEl.parentNode)bootEl.parentNode.removeChild(bootEl);
    topbarEl.hidden=false;sidebarEl.hidden=false;mainEl.hidden=false;

    applyTheme(curTheme);
    initParticles();
    buildToolbar();
    bind();
    applyMode();
    updateCloudUI();
    renderNav();
    onHash();
    window.addEventListener('hashchange',onHash);
    updateScroll();

    var sb=storage.get(K_SIDEBAR);
    if(sb==='open')openSidebar();

    var raw=storage.get(K_GH);
    if(raw){
      try{
        var c=JSON.parse(raw);
        if(c&&c.token){
          gh=c;isAdmin=true;applyMode();updateCloudUI();
          loadAdmin().then(function(list){applyArticles(list);toast('已加载 '+list.length+' 个条目');})
            .catch(function(){loadPublic().then(applyArticles).catch(function(){articles=[];renderStats();showView('home');renderHome();});});
          return;
        }
      }catch(e){}
    }

    loadPublic().then(function(list){applyArticles(list);})
      .catch(function(err){
        console.warn('[wiki] 加载失败',err);
        articles=[];renderStats();showView('home');renderHome();
        cloudSub.textContent='加载失败';
        cloudDot.className='dot';
      });
  }catch(e){
    console.error('[wiki] 启动失败',e);
    var b=$('boot');
    if(b)b.innerHTML='初始化失败：'+(e&&e.message?e.message:e);
  }
}

if(document.readyState==='loading')document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded',boot);
else boot();

})();
</script>
